question: What are current (2025-2026) average Google Ads search benchmarks: CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition? Give numbers by industry where possible.

output.content:
## Current Google Search Ads benchmarks (U.S.)

The most comparable large-sample benchmark is WordStream/LocaliQ’s dataset of **16,446 U.S. search campaigns**, covering approximately **April 2024–March 2025**. It combines Google and Microsoft search data, so treat it as a practical paid-search benchmark—not a pure Google-only statistic. [[1, 2]]

| Metric | 2025 benchmark |
|---|---:|
| Average CTR | **6.66%** |
| Average CPC | **$5.26** |
| Average conversion rate | **7.52%** |
| Average CPA/CPL | **$70.11** |

These figures represent the latest broadly cited 2025 benchmark set. CPC increased **12.88%** year over year, while average CPL increased from **$66.69 to $70.11**. [[1, 3]] 

A newer 2026 edition covering roughly **April 2025–March 2026** reports **6.64% CTR, $5.42 CPC, 8.18% conversion rate, and $66.69 CPL**. [[4, 5]] Because the 2026 data is reported by a different edition and measurement period, use ranges rather than assuming a single universal “current” number.

## 2025 benchmarks by industry

| Shopping, Collectibles & Gifts | 8.92% | $3.49 | 3.83% | $47.94 |
| Sports & Recreation | 9.19% | $2.64 | 7.62% | $47.47 |
| Travel | 8.73% | $2.12 | 5.75% | $73.70 |

 [[6, 7]]

## Practical interpretation

- **Highest CTR:** Arts & Entertainment, **13.10%**; Sports & Recreation, **9.19%**; Shopping/Collectibles, **8.92%**.  
- **Highest CPC:** Legal, **$8.58**; Education, **$6.23**; Home Improvement, **$7.85**; Dental, **$7.85**.  
- **Highest conversion rates:** Automotive repair, **14.67%**; Animals & Pets, **13.07%**; Physicians & Surgeons, **11.62%**; Education, **11.38%**.  
- **Lowest CPL/CPA:** Automotive repair, **$28.50**; Arts & Entertainment and Restaurants, approximately **$30**; Animals & Pets, **$31.82**.  
- **Most expensive acquisition:** Legal, **$131.63**; Furniture, **$121.51**; Business Services, **$103.54**; Real Estate, **$100.48**.

“CPA” is often reported as **CPL** in these datasets. It is therefore most reliable for lead-generation conversions; ecommerce purchase CPA can differ substantially depending on product price, attribution, and conversion definition.

# Google Ads Benchmarks 2025: Competitive Data & Insights for Every Industry
## Key search ads trends: The big picture
This is in line with our data last year, where we saw cost per click (CPC) increase for 86% of industries. The continuing increase in costs is likely due to crowded and unstable SERP conditions, plus increased competition.
- **Conversion rate increased for 65% of industries.** It’s not all bad news! 15 out of 23 of the industries we looked at saw increases in conversion rate (CVR) YoY.
- **Cost per lead increased for 13 out of 23 industries**, although the average increase was only around 5% YoY, noticeably lower than last year’s 25% average increase. However, some industries did see significant decreases, including Career & Employment (46.74%) and Arts & Entertainment (32.28%). An increase in cost per lead (CPL) isn’t surprising given lower CTRs in those industries and increased CPC.
## Microsoft and Google Ads benchmarks for every industry
### Average click-through rate in search ads
While click-through rate isn’t necessarily a “money metric” that ties back directly to your spend, it’s still important to your overall campaign health and ROI. It tells you how clickable your ads are, which you want to prioritize when trying to pull potential customers from the busy SERP.

**The average click-through rate in Google Ads in 2025 is 6.66%.**
Business Category · Average CTR
Animals \& Pets · 6.58%
Apparel / Fashion \& Jewelry · 6.77%
Arts \& Entertainment · 13.10%
Attorneys \& Legal Services · 5.97%
Automotive — For Sale · 8.29%
### Average cost per click in search ads
Click-through rate and cost per click go hand-in-hand in Google Ads. If you’re getting a high click-through rate and high costs per click, you’ll spend your budget faster. That’s why CPC is so dependent on factors such as your bidding strategy, industry competition, and more.

**The average cost per click in Google Ads in 2025 is $5.26.**
Business Category · Average CPC
Animals \& Pets · $3.97
Apparel / Fashion \& Jewelry · $4.31
Arts \& Entertainment · $1.60
Attorneys \& Legal Services · $8.58
Automotive — For Sale · $2.41
Automotive — Repair, Service \& Parts · $3.90
### Average conversion rate in search ads
The industries with the best average conversion rates were Automotive—Repair, Services, & Parts at 14.67%, Animals & Pets at 13.07%, and Physicians & Surgeons at 11.62%.
### Average cost per lead in search ads
#### Average cost per lead: YoY
The overall average cost per lead in Google Ads across all industries went from $66.69 in 2024 to $70.11 in 2025, indicating a 5.13% increase.

# Google Ads Statistics for 2026: Revenue, CTR, CPC, Conversion Rates, Shopping Ads, and Industry Benchmarks
Performance benchmarks from the most recent large-scale campaign data  drawn from over 16,000 campaigns analyzed by WordStream and LocaliQ  show the average click-through rate across all industries at 6.66% in 2025, up from 6.42% in 2024 and a mere 1.35% in 2015.
## Key Google Ads Statistics for 2026
- The average click-through rate across all industries for Google Ads search campaigns in 2025 is 6.66%, based on an analysis of 16,446 U.S.-based campaigns from April 2024 through March 2025 by WordStream and LocaliQ.
- The average cost per click across all industries for Google and Microsoft Ads in 2025 is $5.26, a 12.88% increase over the prior year, based on an analysis of 16,446 campaigns by WordStream and LocaliQ cited by LocaliQ.
- The average conversion rate in Google Ads in 2025 is 7.52%, up from 6.96% in 2024, based on an analysis of 16,446 U.S.-based campaigns by WordStream and LocaliQ.
- The average cost per lead in Google Ads across all industries increased from $66.69 in 2024 to $70.11 in 2025, a 5.13% year-over-year increase, based on an analysis of 16,446 campaigns by WordStream and LocaliQ.
## Click-Through Rate Statistics
- The average CTR for Google Ads search campaigns across all industries in 2025 is 6.66%, up from 6.42% in 2024 and 6.11% in 2023, based on analysis of 16,446 campaigns by WordStream and LocaliQ.
## Cost and Spending Statistics
- The average CPC for Google Ads search campaigns across all industries in 2024 was $4.66, based on an analysis of 17,998 U.S.-based campaigns by WordStream.
- The average CPC across all industries for Google and Microsoft Ads in 2025 rose to $5.26, a 12.88% year-over-year increase, based on an analysis of 16,446 campaigns by WordStream cited by LocaliQ.
## Conversion Rate Statistics
- The average conversion rate in Google Ads improved to 7.52% in 2025, based on an analysis of 16,446 U.S.-based campaigns from April 2024 through March 2025 by WordStream.
- The average conversion rate for Google Ads in 2024 was 6.96%, with Automotive Repair leading at 12.96% and Furniture trailing at 2.53%, based on an analysis of 17,998 campaigns by WordStream.
- The average cost per lead across all industries increased from $66.69 in 2024 to $70.11 in 2025, while cost per lead decreased significantly in Career and Employment by 46.74% and in Arts and Entertainment by 32.28% in the same period, based on an analysis of 16,446 campaigns by WordStream.

# How Much Does Google Ads Cost? 2026 CPC & CPL Benchmarks by Industry
## How Much Does Google Ads Cost in 2026? Average CPC and CPL
Every figure above comes straight from the benchmark tables further down, where they're broken out by industry and channel. The most recent cross-industry Search benchmark data comes from WordStream/LocaliQ's 2025 report, covering more than 16,000 campaigns running from April 2024 through March 2025.
| Metric | Benchmark | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Average Search CTR | 6.66% | WordStream/LocaliQ, updated Sep 29, 2025 |
| Average Search CPC | $5.26 | WordStream/LocaliQ, updated Sep 29, 2025 |
| Average conversion rate | 7.52% | WordStream/LocaliQ, updated Sep 29, 2025 |
| Average cost per lead (CPL) | $70.11 | WordStream/LocaliQ, updated Sep 29, 2025 |
| Ecommerce Search CPC (European) | €0.42 | smec, updated Apr 13, 2026 |
| Ecommerce PMax CPC (European) | €0.41 | smec, updated Apr 13, 2026 |
| Ecommerce Shopping CPC (European) | €0.36 | smec, updated Apr 13, 2026 |
## Why Google Ads Costs Went Up in 2026
WordStream/LocaliQ's benchmark report found that while CPC rose in 87% of industries and the overall average climbed 12.88%, conversion rate actually improved in 65% of industries. CPL rose too, from $66.69 in 2024 to $70.11 in 2025, but that increase was partly driven by CPCs, not purely by falling conversion rates.
## Google Ads Cost FAQ (2026)
### How much does Google Ads cost in 2026?
The latest cross-industry Search benchmark shows an average CPC of **$5.26** and average CPL of **$70.11**, based on more than 16,000 campaigns running April 2024 through March 2025 per WordStream/LocaliQ's 2025 benchmark report.
### Is Google Ads getting more expensive?
WordStream/LocaliQ's latest data found CPC increased for **87% of industries** and the overall average rose **12.88%** year over year. Average CPL climbed from **$66.69 in 2024** to **$70.11 in 2025**, a 5.13% increase.

# Google Ads Benchmarks 2026: CPC, CTR, CVR by Industry
## Headline Google Ads Benchmarks for 2026
| Figure | What it measures | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $5.42 | Median cost per click, US search campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads combined, all industries, April 2025 to March 2026 ($5.26 in the 2025 edition) | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| 6.64% | Median click-through rate, US search campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads combined, all industries, April 2025 to March 2026 (6.66% in the 2025 edition) | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| 8.18% | Median conversion rate, US search campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads combined, all industries, April 2025 to March 2026 (7.52% in the 2025 edition) | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| $66.69 | Median cost per lead, US search campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads combined, all industries, April 2025 to March 2026 ($70.11 in the 2025 edition); WordStream reports this as the first fall in five years | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| 87% | Share of the 23 industries in WordStream and LocaliQ's search benchmarks where the median conversion rate rose between the 2025 and 2026 editions | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| 13,474 | US-based search campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads in WordStream and LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark sample, with at least 52 active campaigns per subcategory (16,446 in the 2025 edition); WordStream describes the results as its clients' performance | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
| $2.32 | Average cost per click in WordStream's first search benchmark report in 2016, less than half its 2026 median of $5.42 (WordStream later updated that page to data as of 2018, with $2.69) | WordStream/LocaliQ, May 18, 2026Benchmark (platform data) |
## What Changed Since Last Year
WordStream describes 2026 as a stable year after two years of sharp rises. Its all-industry median cost per click rose 12.88% between the 2024 and 2025 editions, then only from $5.26 to $5.42 in 2026.
## Widely Quoted Figures, Checked
| Often quoted as | What the source says |
| --- | --- |
| The average Google Ads CPC is about $2.96, with a 3.52% CTR | No WordStream or LocaliQ edition, and no other source cited here, gives these figures. WordStream's older all-industry benchmark (data as of 2018) was $2.69 and 3.17% for search; its 2026 medians for US search campaigns are $5.42 and 6.64%. |
| Google Ads CPCs rose 12% in the past year | That rise (12.88%) was in WordStream's 2025 edition, from $4.66 to $5.26. In the 2026 edition the median moved from $5.26 to $5.42. Alphabet reported cost per click up 3% in Q2 2026. |
| Legal services pay $6.75 per click | That is WordStream's legacy figure (data as of 2018). Its 2026 median for attorneys and legal services is $9.87 per click. |
| A Quality Score of 8 to 10 cuts CPC by 37% against the median | This traces to a 2013 WordStream analysis that modelled the effect of Quality Score on cost per click against an average score of 5. It illustrates how the auction works; it is not a current measurement. |
## Quote the Source, the Measure and the Period
When you quote a Google Ads benchmark, carry the source, the measure and the period with it: "the median cost per click for US search campaigns was $5.42 (WordStream and LocaliQ, April 2025 to March 2026)" is checkable, while "the average Google Ads CPC is $3" is not.
